properties.displayName: OJK - Manual attestation for Monitoring and remediation for Recurring Threats
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure the organization have threat signature detection tools in place, with continous monitor cloud services and assets, prioritized remediation efforts, documented actions, monitoring for recurring threats. (CSPM-155).

metadata.Description:
Continuous Monitoring
Prioritized Remediation Efforts
Documented Actions
Monitoring for Recurring Threats

for more details - refer to Control statement
Continuous Monitoring
1. Implement 24/7 monitoring of cloud services and assets:
- Set up real-time alerting for suspicious activities, such as unusual login patterns or data access attempts
- Implement network traffic analysis (NTA) to identify potential malware infections or data exfiltration attempts
Prioritized Remediation Efforts
1. Develop an AI-driven prioritization system that considers:
- Threat severity based on CVSS scores and potential business impact
- Asset criticality and data sensitivity
- Exploitability in the wild
- Historical context of similar threats
Documented Actions
1. Maintain comprehensive documentation of all threat detection and response activities:
- Generate detailed reports on identified threats, prioritization decisions, and remediation actions
- Use a centralized knowledge base to store common remediation procedures and lessons learned
- Ensure all documentation is easily accessible and searchable for quick reference during incident response
Monitoring for Recurring Threats
1. Implement a system to identify and address recurring threats:
- Implement pattern recognition algorithms to detect similar threat signatures over time
- Conduct regular trend analysis to identify persistent vulnerabilities or attack vectors
- Use machine learning models to predict potential future threats based on historical data
metadata.controlTitle: Ensure the organization have threat signature detection tools in place, with continous monitor cloud services and assets, prioritized remediation efforts, documented actions, monitoring for recurring threats.
